summary: Daqo New Energy Corp. furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited second quarter 2026 earnings press release for the period ended June 30, 2026, signed by Chairman and CEO Xiang Xu. Q2 polysilicon sales rose to 15,190 MT from 4,482 MT, but ASP fell to $4.04/kg from $5.96/kg, producing $62.7 million revenue, an $82.7 million gross loss, and $81.2 million net loss, or $1.20 per ADS. Cash and investments totaled $1.92 billion. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; watch polysilicon pricing and cash burn.
